decisions.reason: The source changes landing-page wording and presentation of the existing giveaway; it does not change random selection, ticket weighting, Chainlink VRF, or the one-winner rule.
The requested hero copy and layout revisions do not change which NFT is minted or how a fiat purchase is fulfilled.
The source only revises landing-page messaging and does not change the deferred Transak on-ramp, its payment methods, wallet provisioning, or mint-delivery behavior.
